description: Land Acquisition - Karawilahena, Naula D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a declaration by the Minister of Lands that specific parcels of land are needed for public purpose and will be acquired. The content includes detailed descriptions of multiple land lots with their boundaries, extents, and survey information. While it mentions a government minister, the core content focuses entirely on land matters (acquisition, boundaries, property descriptions) rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
